communicate ISR (prio 5) can preempt measure1 and zero tickCounter before it is read.
measure2 can write tickCounter between measure1's read and its write.
communicate can write tickCounter between measure1's read and its write.
The non-atomic increment in measure1 can be preempted by measure2's write, so the update is lost.
The non-atomic increment can be preempted by communicate's write, so the update is lost.
communicate can preempt measure2 between its write and its read of tickCounter.
communicate can reset numberOfRecords after measure1 used it as an index and before it increments it.
communicate can reset numberOfRecords between measure1's two reads of it.
The non-atomic increment in measure1 can be preempted by communicate's reset, so the reset is lost.
